decisions.answer: Use Present, Absent (last-minute cancellation/no-show), Cancelled (advance notice; reschedule later). Remove Late from available actions.
Present / (Present + Absent); exclude advance-notice Cancelled and unmarked/future lessons. Example 3 present,1 absent,1 cancelled =75%.
Deactivated students lose portal access immediately; preserve their historical records.

Append every resubmission as a new version; preserve all previous work, grades and feedback in visible history. Grade each new submission independently. Newer graded versions take precedence as current/final grade everywhere; never overwrite previous attempts.
decisions.supersedes: Earlier latest-replaces submission policy and proposed grade-reset/overwrite approach

decisions.answer: Only latest submission version may be graded. Older versions are read-only with existing work/grades/feedback retained; do not require grading superseded ungraded attempts. A new latest version awaits grading and must not inherit an old grade.

Revenue belongs to the invoice lesson/billing month, not payment month. October invoice paid November remains October revenue. Add separate Financial History page with whole financial history, charts/graphics and revenue time-series/bar trends.
Monthly revenue = paid + unpaid invoice amounts attributed to billing month, excluding canceled invoices. Show Paid and Outstanding separately.
Enable persisted drag/reschedule and duration resize for scheduled lessons, with confirmation before saving.
Prevent overlapping lessons across all students on creation, edit/reschedule, drag and resize; canceled lessons do not block a slot.
Remove browser class reminder feature for now (option3). Retain ordinary in-app notifications/inbox.
Enforce0 through assignment maximum inclusive; no negative scores and no extra credit above maximum.

Holiday features and logic are not needed. Remove holiday management UI and holiday-skipping behavior from recurrence generation. Preserve existing historical data safely rather than destructive table deletion.

Inform students of every relevant change concerning them. Use deduplicated in-app events and a conventional small circular numeric unread badge on bell/navigation; show actual unread count and update as notifications arrive/read. Do not expose private teacher/admin information.
Replacement of a free trial remains a free trial; preserve trial classification and zero charge through every reschedule path.

Generate the rest of the entire calendar year: chosen start date through December31 of its year when end date omitted; respect an earlier explicitly chosen end date. Expose generated-through date and prevent duplicate generation.
decisions.source: User said entire year 2026-11-13; calendar-year interpretation stated explicitly

decisions.answer: Canceled lessons must not appear on invoices (latestexplicitconfirmation). Invoice lines show date/time/duration withoutsubject. Every relevantpostedit notifiesstudent. Parent reports are compactexpandabletable rather thanallreportsopen.
